tools.name: get_amplitude_agent_catalog
tools.description: Get Amplitude's catalog of agent-callable resources: MCP servers, the public OpenAPI description, the CLI setup wizard, and published skill libraries. Use this to find a programmatic way into Amplitude data rather than scraping the site.

tools.name: get_amplitude_page_as_markdown
tools.description: Fetch any page on amplitude.com as Markdown, with navigation, forms, and scripts stripped out. Use this to read a page instead of parsing its HTML.

path.description: Site-relative path of the page, for example "/pricing" or "/blog/some-post".

tools.name: list_amplitude_pages
tools.description: Get the llms.txt index of amplitude.com: a categorized list of the site's pages with titles and descriptions. Use this to find which page answers a question before fetching it.

tools.name: search_amplitude_content
tools.description: Full-text search across amplitude.com blog posts, guides, customer stories, and other published content. Returns titles, descriptions, and URLs.

query.description: Search terms, for example "session replay privacy".

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return (1-20).
